It discards manifest lod/release/schema/material/coverage/morph/hash metadata rather than maintaining mutable copies: metadata validation and artifact association remain separate existing contracts, not a generic cache divergence finding.

P16 runtime body preparation caches the first requested base body and loaded fixed designs, with permanent failed status. Requested-base replacement/reset consumers must be traced before claiming ordinary stale body reuse; this source alone gives no supported hot-replacement path. Runtime presentation retains entity/item/placement tuple with worn fallback, requiring caller update lifecycle before stale identity promotion.

Human labels are deliberately separate display vocabulary, especially Ash path versus Ash. Existing round-trip fixture bodies were read, not executed.
